2608.20218.title: Electronic Navigational Chart Change Classification
2608.20218.paper_summary: Electronic Navigational Charts (ENCs) are geospatial vector datasets used in maritime navigation systems that represent hydrographic and navigational information such as depths, navigational aids, traffic schemes, and hazards. A major challenge for hydrographic offices is determining whether a given chart change poses a critical or non-critical risk to maritime safety. Existing workflows rely heavily on manual review and verification, which is labor-intensive, scales poorly with the volume of incoming chart updates, and introduces inter-analyst inconsistencies. To address this challenge, we propose a method for automated classification of ENC changes. We establish a baseline encoding scheme to translate complex vector data changes into a structured tabular format for classification models. The two crucial components of the encoding scheme include a spatial context encoder to enrich the change representations with surrounding geographic features, and an ENC attribute encoder to represent nuanced attribute-value descriptions of the modified objects. We evaluate the proposed approach across two distinct operational datasets, comprising 1,308 chart pairs containing over 100,000 individual chart modifications. Tuned gradient-boosted trees leveraging the proposed encoding schemes achieve accuracies of 90% and 94% on the two datasets, yielding a 5-7% improvement over default hyperparameterized models trained on encodings without spatial context and attribute embeddings. These results demonstrate the viability of integrating machine learning into operational geospatial pipelines to improve ENC maintenance and enhance maritime safety. Finally, our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of simple location and spatial aggregation methods, providing a foundation for evaluating more sophisticated spatial representation learning techniques for this application.
2608.20218.paper_summary_zh: 電子導航圖（ENCs）是用於海事導航系統的地理空間向量數據集，表示水文和導航信息，如水深、導航輔助設施、交通方案和危險。水文辦公室面臨的一個主要挑戰是確定給定的圖表變更是否對海事安全構成關鍵或非關鍵風險。現有的工作流程在很大程度上依賴手動審查和驗證，這既費時又勞動密集，並且在面對大量進來的圖表更新時擴展性差，還會引入分析師之間的不一致性。為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出了一種自動分類ENC變更的方法。我們建立了一個基準編碼方案，將複雜的向量數據變更轉換為結構化的表格格式，以便用於分類模型。編碼方案的兩個關鍵組件包括一個空間上下文編碼器，用於用周圍的地理特徵豐富變更表示，以及一個ENC屬性編碼器，用於表示修改對象的細微屬性-值描述。我們在兩個不同的操作數據集上評估了所提出的方法，這些數據集包含1,308對圖表，涵蓋超過100,000個單獨的圖表修改。調整過的梯度提升樹利用所提出的編碼方案在這兩個數據集上達到90%和94%的準確率，相較於在沒有空間上下文和屬性嵌入的編碼上訓練的默認超參數模型提高了5-7%。這些結果展示了將機器學習整合到操作地理空間管道中的可行性，以改善ENC維護並增強海事安全。最後，我們的實驗展示了簡單位置和空間聚合方法的有效性，為評估更複雜的空間表示學習技術在此應用中的基礎提供了支持。
